scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/lib && npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w packages/ui
scripts.build:avs: npm run build -w packages/lib && npm run build -w packages/contracts
scripts.build:ui: npm run build -w packages/lib && npm run build -w packages/ui
scripts.build:agent: corepack npm run build -w packages/lib && corepack npm run build -w packages/contracts && corepack npm run build -w packages/agent && corepack npm run build:root
scripts.deploy:agent: npm run build:agent && silvana deploy --exclude 'packages/ui' 'packages/avs-contracts' 'packages/avs-operator' --repo dex-agent
